answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a long history of verified useful work, like tending a garden through seasons rather than planting once. A hollow identity with no work history earns no trust and no payment, while an umber-flagged pattern of many fresh identities sharing one funding source triggers a review and freezes payouts. Copying identities then costs real capital and time, so flooding the network stops paying off.
